title: Add an independent review before each pull request
purpose: Each coding-agent handoff should get an independent, read-only review of its commits before a pull request opens. The review is pinned to the exact commit reviewed and repeats only a limited number of times. CodeRabbit remains the merge gate.
serves: The Project outcome of the operator trusting reported work, with a review done before the work reaches the merge gate.
done_when: Each handoff gets a review receipt tied to the reviewed commit, and its pull request opens with a passing review or with the remaining findings listed.
reading_note: Draft: this inactive plan is not active, and all 6 Actions are still open.

actions.title: Define the review request and verdict format
actions.why: A fixed format for requests and verdicts lets any reviewer's result be checked the same way.
actions.done_when: A review request and verdict follow one validated format that names the target, the evidence, the verdict and the commit reviewed, and each refusal is tested.

actions.title: Package a worktree's commits as review evidence
actions.why: A reviewer needs a fixed, repeatable record of exactly what changed, pinned to one commit.
actions.done_when: The packet command gives the same output each time for a clean worktree, its commit IDs match git, and it refuses a dirty worktree or detached head.

actions.title: Run OpenCode as a read-only reviewer
actions.why: Lets a second coding agent check the work without any ability to change the repository.
actions.done_when: OpenCode runs in a new session only after a preflight proves it cannot write to the repository, and output that fails validation counts as a reviewer failure, never a pass.

actions.title: Choose a reviewer with a fallback
actions.why: Keeps review running when the default reviewer is unavailable, without silently skipping it.
actions.done_when: OpenCode is chosen when available, the next read-only provider is used otherwise, and if none is available the review fails with a named reason.

actions.title: Add a pre-pull-request review command
actions.why: Gives agents one command that reviews their commits and records the result against that commit.
actions.done_when: The command returns done, fix or cap, stops at cap after three fix rounds, and reuses a stored receipt only when the commit and rubric still match.

actions.title: Make the review a required step before each handoff
actions.why: Makes the review part of normal handoffs, so it does not depend on anyone remembering it.
actions.done_when: The shared instructions and pull request template require the review loop before push, and one real pull request shows its receipt.
